answer: A voyage is the only passport: a newcomer must complete a public, chained voyage of useful tasks, each leg checked by a different counterparty, each completed leg minting a relic fragment linked to the one before it. Privileges unlock only after a long chain, so a thousand fresh identities buy a thousand empty relics, worth nothing. Faking one leg is easy, but forging a whole chained voyage costs as much work as doing it honestly. If any leg is later proven fake, the ripple invalidates the entire chain and every privilege built on it, collapsing the farm's whole investment from one lie.
